title: Shower Curtain Rod Brackets For 1-Inch Rod, Solid Brass Pair | Antique Pewter | Shower Curtain Rod Brackets | Allied Brass
short_title: Shower Curtain Rod Brackets For 1-Inch Rod, Antique Pewter
description:
Finish your shower curtain rod installation with secure, matching wall brackets designed for a clean, coordinated look in the bathroom in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics.

Highlights:
- Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Fit that matches standard rods: made for use with any 1-inch diameter shower rod
- Coordinate your space: part of the shower curtain rod brackets collection for a cohesive, transitional bathroom hardware look
- Design flexibility: available in multiple designer finish options to complement versatile bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 3 in. x 2.25 in. x 3 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 6 in. x 6 in. x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 2 lbs.
- Includes: (2) brackets (sold as a pair)
- Shower rod: must be purchased separately
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
- Assembly: assembled in the USA
